info.name: FieldKonnect - Odoo Party Prices
info.description: Odoo -> FieldKonnect party-wise pricing, built on the real record Odoo returns from product.pricelist.get_customer_product_price. Set base_url and api_key (test key = odk_test_...). Run folder 1 in order. Spec: odoo-integration-docs/party-prices-api.md

item.name: 0. Odoo source (fetch from Odoo)
item.description: Odoo's own JSON-RPC endpoint, as shared by the Odoo developer. Use it to see the exact records Odoo will push. Fill odoo_session_id and odoo_dev_key in collection variables (do not commit real values).

request.description: Returns result.data[] in the same shape FieldKonnect accepts in POST /party-prices records[].

result.data[0] from Odoo pasted unchanged into records[]. Expected: created (first time) or updated (re-run). Extra field created_at is accepted and kept in raw_payload. Warnings appear if party_code / product_code do not match FieldKonnect.
